redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Licence Ouverte 2.0 material with source, release, transformations, and attribution.
Public API receipts and caches follow current service limits and terms; bulk snapshots are preferred for releases.
A source may validate a release but contributes no published row or geometry.

sources.production_scope: Pinned official CSV or API export under Licence Ouverte 2.0, partitioned by target ISO country.
sources.terms_note: The official dataset maps postal codes to INSEE communes and may expose commune contours or centroids. It explicitly does not provide postal-code boundaries.

sources.provider: Base Adresse Nationale, operated by IGN
sources.production_scope: Pinned BAN bulk snapshot under Licence Ouverte 2.0 with daily-release lineage.
sources.terms_note: BAN is the nationally recognized public address reference and stores address localizers as georeferenced points. It does not make a postal polygon or prove a building relationship by proximity.

sources.provider: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière
sources.production_scope: Pinned BD TOPO release under Licence Ouverte with its address and building-link model preserved.
sources.terms_note: BD TOPO includes BAN address and link classes plus building geometry. Explicit links can support building display; proximity alone remains derived.

sources.provider: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques
sources.production_scope: Pinned annual COG tables with edition and historical crosswalk lineage.
sources.terms_note: COG supplies administrative identities and history, not postal assignment, address points, or polygons.

artifact_partitions.rule: Postal code, INSEE commune, delivery label, and line-five records retain La Poste release and attribution.
BAN address points retain identifiers, position types, certification, source time, and Licence Ouverte attribution.
BD TOPO address-building links and geometry retain product version, link method, identifiers, and IGN attribution.
COG identities and crosswalks remain separate from postal assignment and geometry.
Generated surfaces pin input digests and method and never inherit La Poste assignment authority.
Rows not belonging to FR are routed to their own ISO packs and never published in the FR release.
Non-geographic fixtures only; never promotion evidence.
